Live endpoints /api/admin/deploy-readiness (status=pass, exit_code=0), /run-now (triggered:true), /save-health/alert-config (defaults 20/1h/30min/enabled=true) all healthy. minor.issue: When run back-to-back rapidly, iter51 test_alert_fires_when_threshold_crossed can flake because previous run's alert-config mutation may not have reset to defaults yet (threshold still =20 instead of 2). Isolated pytest runs are clean. Not a code bug; per agent-to-agent note tests must reset config to defaults.

critical_code_review_comments: predeploy_check.sh uses `set -uo pipefail` without `set -e`. The `trap ... ERR` fires on any non-zero cmd. In one back-to-back run it printed 'Stage 1 FAILED' but reported exit 0 in outer shell — worth verifying trap doesn't swallow exit status in edge cases. Currently the `if bash run_regression.sh; then ... else exit 1; fi` block does exit properly on isolated runs.
